exercise.title: 3rd or 5th?
exercise.why: Mi and Sol are the two notes a skip from Do usually lands on, and a minor 3rd sits a half step under Mi, so telling the three apart is half of singing a skip in tune.

cells.text: Press Start below to hear Do and then a note a 3rd or a 5th above it. Sing the second note back on "la", then pick its name: M3 or m3 for a major or minor 3rd, P5 for a 5th.
